h:
我尝试创建最简单的 Ultimate SD Upscale 工作流程。

SFW/NSFW，没关系。

此工作流程旨在升级您创建的已经很棒的图像。

我在 CivitAI 中寻找类似的工作流程，无需意大利面。我想我有一种制作工作流程的方法，其中所有节点都在一个盒子中靠近在一起，有点像 Automatic1111 或 SwarmUI 界面。因为一旦所有内容都配置正确，为什么还要在巨大的画布上移动呢？无论如何...

此工作流程假设您对自己正在做的事情有一个大致的了解。这包括：

  • 为什么您首先使用 SD Ultimate Upscale

  • 您喜欢使用什么高档型号

  • 您要使用的检查点/LoRA/采样参数

    • 我通常使用相同的模型/LoRA/cfg/sampler/scheduler 作为我的原始图像，降噪值为 0.30。积极的提示对我来说只是质量标签，比如“8k、荒谬、杰作”，但这取决于你的目标是什么。

  • 采样器/调度器下方的 Ultimate SD Upscale 节点中的所有参数（mask_blur、tile_padding 等）都旨在进行修改以获得您想要的输出。我在工作流程中拥有的内容适用于我的图像，但您需要对其进行调整和迭代。

它适用于哪些型号？


此工作流程适用于任何使用您在 CivitAI 上找到的标准检查点文件的基于 SDXL 的模型。我专门使用 Illustrious，但我不明白为什么它不能与 Pony、NoobAI 等完全 100% 兼容。

自定义节点

一如既往，我尝试尽可能多地使用核心 ComfyUI 节点，以减少臃肿和烦恼。此工作流程需要 4 个自定义节点包才能工作：

ComfyUI-自定义脚本（对于后端子图中的数学表达式节点）：

https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

rg三舒适（对于很棒的 LoRA 加载器和图像比较器）：

https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale（对于升级节点）：

https://github.com/ssitu/ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale

ComfyUI_tinyterraNodes（对于正负提示节点）：

https://github.com/TinyTerra/ComfyUI_tinyterraNodes

如何使用

  1. 将任何图像拖到“加载输入图像”上（或选择一个文件）。

  2. 根据需要添加 LoRA。

  3. 选择您的高档型号（例如 Real-ESRGAN、NMKD Siax、UltraSharp 等）

  4. 将“Upscale By...”更改为 2（默认 = 2×）、4（4×）、1.5、3，无论您想要什么。该节点以 0.5 为步长递增。

  5. 添加积极和消极的提示。

  6. 在 Ultimate SD Upscale 节点中，根据需要更改步骤/cfg/采样器/调度程序/降噪。

  7. 点击队列提示 → 完成。

您立即得到什么：

  • 完全尊重原始纵横比的放大图像。

  • 将最终放大的图像直接保存到输出文件夹中。

  • 内置并排滑块（rg Three 图像比较器），因此您可以立即查看之前/之后。

幕后发生了什么

有一个橙色的小“后端”框可以自动完成所有的魔法：

  • 检测您的输入分辨率

  • 将宽度和高度乘以您的放大系数 → 计算精确的目标尺寸

  • 将这些目标尺寸输入适当的 SDXL 式调节（正 + 负）

  • 让瓷砖取样器完全了解其目标最终尺寸

请根据需要随意打开或展开子图。

o.en:
I've tried to create the easiest Ultimate SD Upscale workflow possible.

SFW/NSFW, doesn't matter.

This workflow is intended for upscaling the already-awesome images you've created.

I looked around CivitAI for a workflow like this without spaghetti noodles. I guess I have a way of making workflows where all the nodes are close together in a box, kinda like an Automatic1111 or SwarmUI interface. Because once everything is configured correctly, why should you have to move around an enormous canvas? Anyway...

This workflow assumes you have a general understanding of what you're doing. That includes things like:

  • Why you're using SD Ultimate Upscale in the first place

  • What upscale models you like to use

  • The checkpoint/LoRAs/sampling parameters you want to use

    • I usually use identical model/LoRA/cfg/sampler/scheduler as my original image with a 0.30 denoise. Positive prompt is just quality tags for me, like '8k, absurdres, masterpiece', but this depends on what you're aiming for.

  • All of the parameters in the Ultimate SD Upscale node below the sampler/scheduler stuff( mask_blur, tile_padding, etc etc), are intended to be modified to get your desired output. What I have in the workflow is what works for my images but YOU need to tweak it and iterate.

What models does it work with?


This workflow is intended for any SDXL-based model that uses the standard checkpoint file you find on CivitAI. I use Illustrious exclusively but I don't see why it shouldn't completely work 100% with Pony, NoobAI, etc.

Custom nodes

As always, I try to use core ComfyUI nodes as much as possible to reduce bloat and annoyance. This workflow requires 4 custom node packs to work:

ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts(for the math expression nodes in the Backend subgraph):

https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

rgthree-comfy(for the awesome LoRA loader and image comparer):

https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale(for the upscaling node):

https://github.com/ssitu/ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale

ComfyUI_tinyterraNodes(for the positive and negative prompt nodes):

https://github.com/TinyTerra/ComfyUI_tinyterraNodes

How to use it

  1. Drag any image onto “Load Input Image” (or choose a file).

  2. Add LoRAs as needed.

  3. Choose your upscale model (e.g., Real-ESRGAN, NMKD Siax, UltraSharp, etc.)

  4. Change “Upscale By…” to 2 (default = 2×), 4 (4×), 1.5, 3, whatever you want. This node increments in steps of 0.5.

  5. Add your positive and negative prompts.

  6. In the Ultimate SD Upscale node, change around the steps/cfg/sampler/scheduler/denoise as you wish.

  7. Hit Queue Prompt → Done.

What you get instantly:

  • An upscaled image that respects your original aspect ratio exactly.

  • Saves the final upscaled image straight to your output folder.

  • Built-in side-by-side slider (rgthree Image Comparer) so you can see before/after instantly.

What happens behind the scenes

There’s one tiny orange “Backend” box that does all the magic automatically:

  • Detects your input resolution

  • Multiplies width & height by your upscale factor → calculates exact target dimensions

  • Feeds those target dimensions into proper SDXL-style conditioning (positive + negative)

  • Gives the tiling sampler perfect knowledge of the final size it’s aiming for

Feel free to open or expand the subgraph as needed.
